notes: Researched bulk named-site sources. These are not materialized until jurisdiction-specific ingest is implemented.

bourgogne_maps_bulk.authority: Bureau Interprofessionnel des Vins de Bourgogne (BIVB) / Bourgogne Maps
bourgogne_maps_bulk.coverage_note: BIVB reports 11,541 identified Climats and lieux-dits and 296,663 mapped parcels across the Bourgogne Maps GIS. This tranche does not bulk-copy all names because the public map is informational and no stable bulk-name export was located.

rlp_weinbergsrolle.coverage_note: Official Weinbergsrolle / Weinlagen register. LWK states its map exposes over 1,600 Einzellagen and registered Gewannen; a 2024 PDF contains lagennummer, Einzellage, Gemeinde/Gemarkung and planted area.

noe_rieden_open_data.authority: Land Niederösterreich, Abteilung BD1 - GIS Support
noe_rieden_open_data.coverage_note: Official open-data vineyard Rieden dataset with WFS/GeoJSON and fields for cadastral municipality, political municipality, Weinbauflur, Riede, Subriede, implementation status and last update. State notes coverage is not yet statewide complete.

vienna_rieden.coverage_note: Official Vienna Riedenkarte contains all 140 Weinbaurieden with exact parcel-level delimitations and traditional names.
